bout.identity_discriminator: Bruno Fernandes Rocha = ROYAL-BLUE short-sleeve rashguard, black shorts, CYAN tape on the LEFT ankle, tattoo on the left forearm and the right shin. Bryan Silva = navy/black rashguard with a Brazil flag on the right shoulder, black shorts with a white 'GRA...' logo down the leg. Bound to names WITHOUT using the lower-third graphic (whose blue/red blocks are pure left/right design -- the same graphic puts Bruno on the blue side here and on the red side in video 15547218). Instead: the royal-blue/cyan-tape body is the SAME man, kit for kit and tattoo for tattoo, as the athlete in video 15547218 (same event, same day), and Bruno is the only athlete common to both videos, so that body is Bruno. The referee raises HIS arm at t=123 -> Bruno won.
bout.notes: Bout window: engagement begins t~11-16, referee resets them standing t~17-24 (out of bounds at the white line), clock graphic first appears at t=33 reading 5:45 and runs 1:1 with video (5:43@36, 5:39@40, 5:29@50); frozen at 4:28 from t=111 -> finish at t~111, 92s of a 6:00 match. Extrapolating 6:00 from the clock alone gives a start of t=19; the frames show them already fighting at t=12, so ~7s of that is the reset stoppage and bout_start is taken as 11. This graphic shows NO points column at all, so nothing in this bout is scoreboard-corroborated. Camera is far and both kits read dark on a grey mat: top/bottom is only legible from ~t=68 onward, which is why most of the mid-bout reading is dropped rather than corrected. Kept 3 of 9 events read.
